subject: Money
title: The 21 Million Cap
description: A quick win: understand The 21 Million Cap.

hook.text: Only 21 million Bitcoin will ever exist. 19.5 million have been mined already. The last one arrives around year 2140.

buildup.text: Unlike dollars, which governments print endlessly, Bitcoin's supply is fixed in code. No central bank can create more.

discovery.text: Every 4 years, the mining reward halves. 50 BTC in 2009, 25 in 2012, 6.25 in 2020, 3.125 in 2024. Shrinking supply.

twist.text: Scarcity doesn't guarantee value. Plenty of rare things are worthless. Bitcoin's value comes from belief plus scarcity.

climax.text: The cap makes Bitcoin deflationary by design. As supply growth slows and demand grows, price pressure is upward.

punchline.text: Can't print more. That's the whole point.

quiz.question: What is the maximum number of Bitcoin that will ever exist?
